_what: Which committed receipt each card replays (cards, by device name) and which an unlisted card of a recorded architecture replays (architectures, "major.minor"). Read by this fixture's parity tests and by tools/advect_wrf471_oracle/recapture_receipt.py, which adds a card here when it installs that card's first capture. uncertified_stale records, per receipt of an architecture older than Blackwell, the commit that left its pins behind and those pins: byte identity is certified on Blackwell and newer only (ruling 2026-10-04), so such a receipt is reported, not gated, and recapture_receipt.py --install drops its record.
